scope: Hand-declared synthetic 4769 inputs and expected candidate alerts; exact finite rolling (t-5m,t] windows. Labels describe rule outcomes, not ground truth attack confirmation or operational precision.

cases.name: four_service_accounts_below_threshold
cases.reason: Four distinct service SIDs cannot meet the threshold of five.

cases.name: five_service_accounts_threshold
cases.reason: Five simultaneous successful RC4 requests for five service SIDs produce one candidate.

cases.name: many_requests_four_service_accounts
cases.reason: Repeated requests do not turn four distinct service accounts into five.

cases.name: five_service_aliases_one_sid
cases.reason: Five different ServiceName values for one service SID are one account, not five SPNs.

cases.name: same_service_name_five_sids
cases.reason: ServiceName equality does not collapse five independently identified service accounts.

cases.name: service_name_optional_context
cases.reason: Validated service SIDs are sufficient; optional ServiceName is not a grouping or count key.

cases.name: failure_cannot_supply_fifth_service
cases.reason: A failed TGS request must not supply the fifth successful RC4 service account.

cases.name: aes_cannot_supply_fifth_service
cases.reason: A successful AES256 ticket is outside this RC4-only candidate.

cases.name: aes128_only_out_of_scope
cases.reason: Five AES128 tickets do not match; absence of a candidate does not rule out AES roasting.

cases.name: aes256_only_out_of_scope
cases.reason: Five AES256 tickets do not match; this rule does not cover every Kerberoasting variant.

cases.name: requester_groups_do_not_merge
cases.reason: Four requests from one group plus one with a different user.name do not qualify.

cases.name: domain_groups_do_not_merge
cases.reason: Four requests from one group plus one with a different user.domain do not qualify.

cases.name: source_ip_groups_do_not_merge
cases.reason: Four requests from one group plus one with a different source.ip do not qualify.

cases.name: machine_requester_is_not_blanket_excluded
cases.reason: A trailing dollar sign is not evidence that a requester cannot be abused.

cases.name: same_requester_across_domain_controllers
cases.reason: DC event-host names do not split the same requester/domain/IP service-account burst.

cases.name: domain_controller_name_optional
cases.reason: Optional DC context is not a requester identity or aggregation key.

cases.name: exact_five_minute_lower_boundary_expires
cases.reason: At 00:05 the four events exactly at 00:00 have expired from the exclusive lower bound.

cases.name: one_microsecond_inside_lower_boundary
cases.reason: Four requests one microsecond after the lower boundary are still counted.

cases.name: one_microsecond_before_expiry
cases.reason: The fifth ticket arrives one microsecond before the first four expire.

cases.name: one_microsecond_after_expiry
cases.reason: Expired requests must not re-enter a window due to millisecond rounding.

cases.name: burst_straddles_fixed_bucket_boundary
cases.reason: A two-second burst remains one rolling window across a five-minute clock boundary.

cases.name: timestamp_ties_are_atomic
cases.reason: Six simultaneous records produce one candidate with five distinct accounts and six requests.

cases.name: identical_duplicate_id_does_not_inflate
cases.reason: An identical repeated event ID does not increase requests or distinct service accounts.

cases.name: duplicate_below_threshold_stays_below
cases.reason: Replaying the fourth request cannot create a fifth service account.

cases.name: timezone_equivalent_duplicate_id
cases.reason: Timezone-equivalent copies of the same immutable record are counted once.

cases.name: each_qualifying_anchor_emits
cases.reason: A sixth service at a later anchor produces another candidate; this is not incident suppression.

cases.name: bounded_replay_uses_history_and_excludes_end
cases.reason: History before start contributes; the anchor exactly at end is excluded.

cases.name: missing_service_sid_is_not_a_service_name_fallback
cases.reason: Missing service.id remains unknown and cannot supply the fifth qualifying service.

cases.name: missing_requester_cannot_join_group
cases.reason: Missing user.name remains unknown and cannot supply the fifth qualifying service.

cases.name: missing_domain_cannot_join_group
cases.reason: Missing user.domain remains unknown and cannot supply the fifth qualifying service.

cases.name: missing_source_ip_cannot_join_group
cases.reason: Missing source.ip remains unknown and cannot supply the fifth qualifying service.

cases.name: missing_status_is_not_success
cases.reason: Missing win.status remains unknown and cannot supply the fifth qualifying service.

cases.name: missing_encryption_is_not_rc4
cases.reason: Missing ticket.encryption_type remains unknown and cannot supply the fifth qualifying service.

cases.name: null_service_sid_is_unknown
cases.reason: Null service identity must not fall back to a distinct ServiceName.

cases.name: null_encryption_is_unknown
cases.reason: Null encryption is preserved as unknown, not inferred to be RC4.

cases.name: missing_sid_cannot_add_request_or_anchor
cases.reason: The later record has no service SID: it cannot add an RC4 request or create an eligible anchor after a valid five-service burst.

cases.name: wrong_event_code_cannot_supply_fifth
cases.reason: Invalid present event.code cannot supply the fifth service; strict profile rejects the batch.

cases.name: wrong_dataset_cannot_supply_fifth
cases.reason: Invalid present event.dataset cannot supply the fifth service; strict profile rejects the batch.

cases.name: numeric_event_code_is_not_normalized
cases.reason: Invalid present event.code cannot supply the fifth service; strict profile rejects the batch.

cases.name: text_status_is_not_normalized
cases.reason: Invalid present win.status cannot supply the fifth service; strict profile rejects the batch.

cases.name: boolean_status_is_not_success
cases.reason: Invalid present win.status cannot supply the fifth service; strict profile rejects the batch.

cases.name: text_encryption_is_not_normalized
cases.reason: Invalid present ticket.encryption_type cannot supply the fifth service; strict profile rejects the batch.

cases.name: blank_service_sid_is_not_identity
cases.reason: Invalid present service.id cannot supply the fifth service; strict profile rejects the batch.

cases.name: benign_legacy_application_rc4_fanout
cases.reason: A known authorized legacy reporting service requests five RC4 service tickets. The pattern matches despite benign intent; investigate context and tune scoped exceptions.
